Get Crashes By Vehicle

Source: R/get_fars_crash_vehicles.R
get_fars_crash_vehicles.Rd

This function returns a list of fatal crashes involving a specific vehicle make, model, model year, and body type using the CrashAPI GetCrashesByVehicle endpoint. The make, model, and body type can be names or ID numbers matching the options returned by fars_vars(). Names are converted to ID numbers for use in the API query.

Usage

get_fars_crash_vehicles(
  state,
  make,
  model,
  model_year,
  body_type,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  var_labels = c("attribute", "none")
)

Arguments

state

Required. State name, abbreviation, or FIPS number.

make

Required. Make name or ID, e.g. "Ford" or 12. Valid options are returned by fars_vars(var = "make") for the earliest year in year.

model

Required. Model name or ID. Valid options are returned by fars_vars(var = "model", make = make).

model_year

Required. Vehicle model year.

body_type

Required. Body type name or ID. Valid options are returned by fars_vars(var = "bodytype", make = make, model = model).

year

numeric vector. One or more years from 2010 to 2024. The minimum and maximum values are used as the start and end year. Defaults to getOption("crashapi.year", 2024).

var_labels

How to add variable labels from fars_vars_labels: "attribute" (default) adds a "label" attribute to each column, which is shown by View() in RStudio and Positron and used by packages such as gt and gtsummary, and "none" doesn't add variable labels.

API behavior

NHTSA's documentation says this endpoint accepts "one or more" vehicle details for make, model, model year, and body type. However, testing in October 2026 found that the API does not behave this way: the API returns an error (HTTP 404) unless all four are provided and an error message if any are blank. For this reason, make, model, model_year, and body_type are all required.

To find crashes using other vehicle criteria, download the vehicle table with get_fars_year() using type = "vehicle" and filter the data.

Examples

get_fars_crash_vehicles(
  state = "CA",
  make = "Ford",
  model = 37,
  model_year = 2012,
  body_type = 4,
  year = 2022
)
